subject: Intro: Buildly quickstart -> technical demo availability
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@buildly.com>
To: docs@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quickstart signup — interest in technical demo

Hi Redwood team,

I just finished the quickstart guide and got a good prototype running locally — thanks for the clear docs. I'm Liam, engineering lead at Buildly. We're evaluating ways to reduce inference latency for our code-generation assistant (low-batch, <50ms token latency target) and exploring prefix caching and quantized models.

Would like to book a technical demo and dig into:
- model variants you recommend for low latency
- KV cache strategies for our streaming use case
- security options for data-in-flight

Attached is a small export from our quickstart runs (quickstart-export.pdf) with perf numbers. Prefer mornings PST next week. Can you point me to an engineer for the deep dive?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Engineering Lead, Buildly
liam@buildly.com

---
Attachment: quickstart-export.pdf (pdf, 145 KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart signup — interest in technical demo

Hi Liam — great to meet you and thanks for trying the quickstart. I'm Aditya on the SDR/Developer outreach team at Redwood.

Really appreciate the perf export — that gives us a helpful starting point. Monica (copied) is our solutions engineer and would lead the technical deep dive. Marissa is the AE on rotation and will join to capture requirements.

Are you available for a 30–45 minute technical session on any of the following slots (all PST):
- Tue Apr 6 — 10:00–10:45am
- Tue Apr 6 — 3:00–3:45pm
- Wed Apr 7 — 9:00–9:45am

If none work, reply with times that do and we can accommodate. You can also pick a time directly on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/aditya/30min

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick overview of Buildly's quickstart export (you)
2) Latency & KV-cache tradeoffs (Monica)
3) Deployment options & security controls (Marissa)
4) Next steps / follow-up eval plan

I'll attach a placeholder calendar invite once we land on a time.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
SDR — Developer Outreach
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
